package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestProjectAuthoringMigrationPinsImmutableInputAndCASLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/015_project_authoring_flow.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sql := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"CREATE TABLE project_authoring_flow", "UNIQUE(student_id, idempotency_key)",
		"learning_path_version bigint NOT NULL", "path_snapshot_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL",
		"authoring_profile_version bigint NOT NULL", "authoring_profile_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL",
		"authoring_request_json jsonb NOT NULL", "authoring_input_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL",
		"confirmation_idempotency_key", "tz_authoring_job_id", "ready_blueprint_digest",
		"publication_idempotency_key", "publication_receipt_json", "status='PUBLISHED'",
		"version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1", "FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_identity_mutation()",
		"NEW.authoring_profile_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_profile_version",
		"NEW.authoring_profile_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_profile_digest",
		"OLD.authoring_request_json", "OLD.ready_at IS NOT NULL", "OLD.publication_receipt_json IS NOT NULL",
		"CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_project_authoring_live_snapshot", "WHERE status <> 'FAILED'",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(sql, required) {
			t.Fatalf("migration is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"answers_json", "mastery_json", "profile_json", "generated_source", "reference_solution", "sandbox_id"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(sql), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("migration persists forbidden project data %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestProjectAuthoringRepositoryUsesVersionCASAndClaimsOnlyConfirmedOrExplicitPublish(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("project_authoring_flow.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"status IN ('CONFIRMED','AUTHORING') OR (status='READY' AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL)",
		"FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED", "version=flow.version+1", "AND version=$6",
		"status='READY' AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL", "claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL",
		"ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", "GetCurrentProjectAuthoringFlow", "status <> 'FAILED'",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("repository is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	columns := splitCoursePlanColumns(projectAuthoringColumns)
	prefixed := splitCoursePlanColumns(prefixedProjectAuthoringColumns("flow"))
	if len(columns) != 40 || len(prefixed) != len(columns) {
		t.Fatalf("project authoring projection count=%d/%d, want 40", len(columns), len(prefixed))
	}
	for index := range columns {
		if strings.TrimPrefix(prefixed[index], "flow.") != columns[index] {
			t.Fatalf("column[%d]=%q/%q", index, columns[index], prefixed[index])
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(source, "&flow.AuthoringProfileVersion, &flow.AuthoringProfileDigest") {
		t.Fatal("repository scan does not restore immutable authoring profile provenance")
	}
}

func TestStagingCheckpointIsPrivateImmutableAndSeparateFromPublication(t *testing.T) {
	migration, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/018_project_authoring_staging.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source, err := os.ReadFile("project_authoring_flow.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, wanted := range []string{"practice-task-staging-receipt.v1", "trg_project_authoring_staging_immutable", "staging_receipt_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_receipt_json", "status='STAGED'", "publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(migration), wanted) {
			t.Fatalf("missing staging invariant: %s", wanted)
		}
	}
	for _, wanted := range []string{"SET status='STAGED', tz_job_status='STAGED'", "staging_receipt_json=$11", "domain.ValidateTZAuthoringJob(job)", "job.Status != domain.TZAuthoringStaged"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(source), wanted) {
			t.Fatalf("missing staged persistence: %s", wanted)
		}
	}
}
